headlines.text: It was 2021 when the IWGP United States Title changed hands as Lance Archer vs. Jon Moxley battled it out in a Texas Death Match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.94 ? a match that delivered ? ending the champion's reign at 3 defenses. A brutal Texas Death Match rated near four-and-a-half stars by fans ? Archer's hometown crowd roared him on through forks, barbed wire boards, and a fan getting thrown into the ring, and Moxley showed real respect afterward, handing Archer the title himself.

Flash back to 2023, when Darby Allin vs. Angelo Parker vs. Big Bill vs. Bishop Kaun vs. Brian Cage vs. Ethan Page vs. Isiah Kassidy vs. Jake Hager vs. Jay Lethal vs. Jeff Jarrett vs. Komander vs. Matt Hardy vs. Matt Menard vs. Matt Sydal vs. Minoru Suzuki vs. Nick Wayne vs. Swerve Strickland vs. The Butcher vs. The Blade vs. Toa Liona fought it out in a Royal Rampage match, opening the card on Rampage, rated 6.51, part of the special Royal Rampage '23 card.
Back on this day in 2023, Kris Statlander vs. Marina Shafir fought tooth and nail for the AEW TBS Title, appearing on Rampage, rated 5.10. A hard-fought battle for the gold.

secondaries.text: 2021 brought us this moment: Chris Jericho vs. Shawn Spears met in a Qualifying Match, getting things started right out of the gate on Dynamite, rated 6.35, part of the special Fyter Fest - Night 2 '21 card.
Looking back to 2023, when QTV (Marshall, Solow & TV) arrived in AEW as a team, appearing on Rampage, rated 5.32.
Flash back to 2021, when it marked the first-ever meeting between Orange Cassidy and The Blade on Dynamite, rated 5.62.
